name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods for subagent visibility, task tracking, token savings and daily workflow.

plugins.name: agent-monitor
plugins.description: Sidebar of every subagent: task, live activity, model, time, tokens, history.

plugins.name: task-inbox
plugins.description: Claude's live plan, your to-dos, and an inbox you dispatch to background subagents.

plugins.name: token-saver
plugins.description: Cheaper-model routing for subagents, lean-output rules, duplicate-read guard, usage HUD, model advisor.

plugins.name: daily-driver
plugins.description: Focus goal band, finish notifications, daily work log (/eod), and /handoff + /pickup across sessions.

plugins.name: clarify-first
plugins.description: Asks 2-4 high-leverage multiple-choice questions before complex tasks and deep questions; everyday prompts pass untouched.
